content.title: Latto Announces Pregnancy, Flaunts Baby Bump in New Video for “Business & Personal”
content.text: Latto has confirmed her pregnancy and shared the release date for her upcoming album, BIG MAMA. The rapper also released the video for her new song, “Business & Personal,” which seemingly gives a glimpse of her boyfriend, 21 Savage.The 27-year-old first teased the announcement with a teaser shared on Thursday afternoon (March 19). In the short visual, she’s seen walking towards a baby cheetah, before feeding it from a bottle.“I ain't go missing. I had to give y'all time to miss me,” Latto is heard saying in the voice over. “Before you run the game, you got to take baby steps to go the distance. Home to the studio, studio back home.”She continued, “Listening to every beat, feeling every kick. Ever since I was a little girl, I always dreamed of having my own. Big Mama, but this time the stake's way bigger. Now it's on me to deliver.”Despite speculation dating back to 2020, Latto finally confirmed her relationship with 21 Savage while speaking to a TMZ photographer in September 2025.The Sugar Honey Iced Tea rapper told TMZ at the time that she was on her way “to go have this dinner with my husband" while in New York City.“Wait, so are you tired of people asking about you-know-who?” a photographer asked before she clarified that she meant 21 Savage.“No,” she replied politely, before giving an enthusiastic, “My man, my man, my man, my man.”The following month, Latto seemingly shut down rumors that she was pregnant after fans claimed she had a baby bump during her performance at the Force Fest in Japan.“I ate tew much wagyu & ramen,” she wrote in a since-archived Instagram post.
